AngleExpr.description: An angle: a number of degrees, or an expression such as "30 deg" or "a / 2".

LengthExpr.description: A length: a number in the design's length unit, or an expression such as "w / 2" or "30 mm".

Point3.description: A point in mm: [x, y, z] or {"x", "y", "z"}.

StringList.description: A name, or a list of names.

Touching.description: What a join makes of pieces that share no face: separate (the default) makes each piece that touches another only along an edge or at a point a body of its own and keeps pieces that touch nothing in one body; one_body keeps every piece in one body.

input.description:
Add a rest: a pad standing on a face for another part to rest on, round or rectangular, solid
or hollow. It joins the body it stands on. One undo step.

along.description: The direction of a rectangular rest's `length`: across `direction`, not zero.

body.description: The body it stands on, by name. Default: the body at `position`.

body_names.description: Names for the new bodies, in order.

direction.description: The direction the feature stands out of the face, not zero. Default: square out of the face at `position`, which must then be planar.

draft.description:
The pad's draft, under 57°: it narrows towards its top by this angle. Default: the body's
plastic rule's draft, or none.

height.description: How far the pad stands out of the face, at least 0.01 mm.

length.description: A rectangular rest's length, along `along`. Default: a round rest.

name.description: The feature's name in the timeline.

participants.description:
The bodies taking part, each an existing body or `*`; what that changes depends on the
feature.

position.description: A point in mm on the face the feature stands on: [x, y, z] or {"x", "y", "z"}.

thickness.description: A hollow rest's wall thickness. Default: a solid rest.

touching.description: What a join makes of pieces that share no face. Default: separate.

width.description: The pad's width at the face: a round rest's diameter.

input.title: RestParams

label: Rest

FeatureNotice.description: Something a feature's result tells the user without stopping them, with an action to take.

action.description: The command that changes the feature as the notice offers.

contact.description:
How the bodies split off touched the others: `along_edge`, `at_point` or `touching` (along
a line or at a point their boundaries don't hold).

NoticeAction.description: A command a notice offers to run.

changed_bodies.description: Bodies that were there before and now have other geometry.

ms.description: How long the feature took to evaluate, in milliseconds.

notice.description:
A join that split pieces into bodies of their own because they touch the others only along
an edge or at a point (its `touching: separate`): what to tell the user, and the edit that
makes them one body instead. Left out otherwise, also when the join kept pieces that touch
nothing in one body.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

warning.description:
A warning from the evaluation (a Boolean that needed a retry, a reference found again
elsewhere), or `null`.

params: position: [x,y,z] on a face (the rest's centre); direction? (default: out of the face); width (round: the diameter); length? (a rectangle, along `along`); along?: [x,y,z]; height; draft? (angle; default: the body's plastic rule); thickness? (wall of a hollow rest); body?
